subject: Procurement orchestration: staged capacity uplift and onboarding refresh
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: Anika Bose <anika.bose@solstice.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal notice + vendor onboarding refresh / capacity uplift

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you’re well — we’re coming up on our contract renewal with Redwood on June 30 and I wanted to start the procurement conversation early. We plan to expand usage: current committed capacity is ~10M tokens/month; target is 18M tokens/month over the next 12 months (we expect a quick ramp in Q3).

Procurement team has asked us to refresh vendor onboarding records in their portal (new vendor code, updated W-9, updated SOW reflecting the term & capacity). I’ve attached the current SOW (Solstice_SOW_v1.pdf) for reference.

Could Redwood provide a mutual action plan and a pre-filled PO template to accelerate review? Also let me know if you accept split POs across regions — our finance team sometimes sends multiple POs for a single contract.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director of Data & AI
Solstice Systems
--
Attachment: Solstice_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf, 185 KB)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice.com>
Cc: Anika Bose <anika.bose@solstice.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice + vendor onboarding refresh / capacity uplift

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the SOW. Putting a short mutual action plan below to keep momentum. I copied Karthik (sales engineering) to confirm technical/pricing constraints.

Mutual action plan (proposed)
1) Redwood sends: updated SOW draft (term + capacity), pre-fill PO template, procurement evidence checklist. (ETA: 1 business day)
2) Solstice completes: portal invite acceptance, uploads W-9, confirms vendor code details, submits procurement questions. (ETA: 3 business days)
3) Redwood & Solstice align on billing split / PO segmentation if needed; finalize PO. (ETA: 2 business days)
4) Redwood onboarding ops schedules capacity uplift / validation run once PO received. (ETA: within contract start)

Notes/questions:
- We can support segmented POs (split billing) but need clear PO-to-region mapping and expected chargeback instructions.
- Standard term options: 12 months, 24 months (we can offer volume-based discounts at 24 months). Karthik — I’ll let you propose the price delta for 12 vs 24 months and confirm whether ramp pricing is needed.

I attached a revised SOW (Solstice_SOW_v2.pdf) with the capacity uplift and a pre-fill PO template. Also sharing the procurement portal invite link so your procurement team can upload documents: https://redwood.procure-portal.com/solstice-invite-ABC123

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min procurement/finance sync with our procurement ops this week to pre-fill the PO together.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: Solstice_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf, 202 KB); pre-fill-PO-template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24 KB)

From: Anika Bose <anika.bose@solstice.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice + vendor onboarding refresh / capacity uplift

Thanks Jasmine — quick procurement clarifying questions from our side:

1) Billing contact: who should the PO be sent to (email + contact name)?
2) SOC 2 / security evidence: do you have a vendor portal link or a one-pager we can attach to our intake? (our security team requires SOC2 Type II and data-retention policies)
3) Term flexibility: can Redwood do a 12-month renewal with an option to extend at a pre-agreed rate? Our budget owners prefer shorter commitments but will consider 24 months with a discount.
4) PO split: If we submit 2 POs (one for NA, one for EMEA), will Redwood be able to consolidate reporting and invoice as a single account?

I attached a short procurement questionnaire (procurement-questions.xlsx) to capture the fields our ERP requires. Also — we’ll need a vendor tax form (W-9) and the updated SOW flagged in the portal.

If it helps, Liam and I can join a joint procurement call next week to walk our finance folks through the portal.

Regards,
Anika Bose
Head of Procurement
Solstice Systems
--
Attachment: procurement-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet, 15 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anika Bose <anika.bose@solstice.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solstice.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice + vendor onboarding refresh / capacity uplift

Anika — thanks for the questions. Short answers and next steps below.

1) Billing contact / PO routing:
- Preferred PO email: billing@redwood.com (Accounts Payable). For handoffs, please also copy billing-ops@redwood.com and include account id SOL-7591 in the PO description.
- We can accept two POs (NA + EMEA). Please include the region code on each PO (NA / EMEA) — we will consolidate reporting to the single Solstice account in our console.

2) SOC 2 / security evidence:
- SOC2 Type II report is available via our vendor portal: https://redwood.com/security/soc2 (internal link; we can provide a secure download link to your security team after an NDA).
- Attached is a procure evidence checklist that calls out typical artifacts procurement teams ask for. If you need a specific export, let us know and we can route to security.

3) Term flexibility / pricing:
- We can do a 12-month term with a 30-day optional extension, or a 24-month term with a tiered discount (we typically provide 8-12% off list depending on committed capacity). I’ll have pricing broken out in a short amendment doc after Marissa reviews the commercial.

Next steps (action items):
- Jasmine: please open an onboarding-ops ticket to schedule capacity validation once PO received.
- Marissa: I’ll follow up with a commercial amendment (12 vs 24 month numbers) by EOD tomorrow.
- Solstice: please upload W-9 and complete procurement-questions.xlsx in the portal.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142
--
Attachments: procure-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf, 88 KB); billing-split-guidance.docx (docx, 14 KB)
